g.text: internalAuthMiddleware: delete any X-Internal-Auth-* without a valid MAC

text.tspan: stripInboundInternalAuthHeaders, then set Validated, Namespace, JWT-Sub,

g.text: sign MAC v1, v2, v3 with HKDF(secret, internal-auth-hop)
proxy over the overlay with headers and three MACs
newest MAC present is the only one checked, |skew| at most 60 s

text.tspan: valid: delete fields newer than that version, delete MACs
